content.title: Chapter 1 - GENERAL PROVISIONS — Sec. 1-1. - How Code designated and cited.
content.summary:
The ordinances embraced in this and the following chapters and sections shall constitute
               and be designated the "Code of the City of Arvada, Colorado," and may be so cited.
               Such ordinances may also be cited as the "Arvada City Code."
(Code 1960, § 1-1; Code 1981, § 1-1)
